mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_search_usage_daily (user_id, usage_date, operation, request_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{usageDate}, #{operation}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (user_id, usage_date, operation) DO UPDATE SET request_count = map_search_usage_daily.request_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE map_search_usage_daily.request_count < #{dailyLimit}

INSERT INTO map_search_usage_daily (user_id, usage_date, operation, rejected_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{usageDate}, #{operation}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (user_id, usage_date, operation) DO UPDATE SET rejected_count = map_search_usage_daily.rejected_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
